from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace/programs/task-40e4f0fb.py')
code='''def transform(grid):\n    """Extend each non-background row's rightmost colored cell to the edge in color 1."""\n    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for row in out:\n        occupied = [i for i, value in enumerate(row) if value != bg]\n        if occupied:\n            for i in range(occupied[-1] + 1, len(row)):\n                row[i] = 1\n    return out\n'''
